## What are you trying to remove from your Reddit feed?

Describe the annoying/repetitive content pattern rather than only the implementation you have in mind.

## Why can't the current controls handle it well?

Current first-class controls are words/phrases, subreddits, users, domains, flairs, scope, duration, presets, and Recently Hidden review.
